endorsements.quote: Thus, without continuous monitoring, performance can quietly degrade, a process referred to as “model drift”.
MLOps provides structured processes for version control, validation, performance monitoring, bias surveillance, retraining, and governance, so that predictions remain clinically valid over P.
Clinical trust must be gained prior to adoption.

unlisted_practices: Pursue multicenter data sharing to build larger, more diverse datasets for training and validating AI models.
Perform external validation of AI models at different centers before use across health systems.
Develop explainable AI models, such as SHAP values, so clinicians can understand why a model flagged a patient as high-risk.
Adopt a rigorous ethical framework to prevent algorithmic bias from historical data.
Conduct real-world evidence studies to evaluate the cost-effectiveness and patient outcome impact of AI integration.
